companion.name: companion_dirty_sources
companion.sql:
CREATE TABLE companion_dirty_sources (
        source_table TEXT NOT NULL,

      )

companion.name: companion_environments
companion.sql:
CREATE TABLE companion_environments (
        environment_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES environments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        project_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        environment_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        provider TEXT,
        spec_revision INTEGER,
        spec_source_kind TEXT CHECK (spec_source_kind IN ('repo', 'local')),
        observation_coverage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'
          CHECK (observation_coverage IN ('none', 'complete', 'partial', 'unobservable', 'failed')),
        latest_attempt_at TEXT,
        latest_attempt_outcome TEXT,
        latest_complete_at TEXT,
        latest_complete_spec_revision INTEGER,
        observed_fingerprint TEXT,
        drift_fingerprint TEXT,
        latest_attempt_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
          CHECK (json_valid(latest_attempt_json)),
        latest_complete_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
          CHECK (json_valid(latest_complete_json)),
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (project_id, environment_name)
      )

companion.name: companion_meta
companion.sql:
CREATE TABLE companion_meta (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
        schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        min_reader_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        max_reader_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        writer_version TEXT NOT NULL,
        projection_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        projection_dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (projection_dirty IN (0, 1)),
        dirty_reason TEXT,
        source_changed_at TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

companion.name: companion_plans
companion.sql:
CREATE TABLE companion_plans (
        plan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        environment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES environments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        environment_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        preview_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        applicability TEXT NOT NULL
          CHECK (applicability IN (
            'awaiting_apply', 'empty', 'blocked', 'expired',
            'spec_superseded', 'live_state_changed', 'claimed',
            'applied', 'consumed', 'unsupported_legacy'
          )),
        is_latest_for_environment INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
          CHECK (is_latest_for_environment IN (0, 1)),
        spec_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        observed_fingerprint TEXT,
        expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        claimed_at TEXT,
        apply_run_id TEXT,
        apply_outcome TEXT,
        preview_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(preview_json)),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

companion.name: companion_runs
companion.sql:
CREATE TABLE companion_runs (
        run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        environment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES environments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        source_plan_id TEXT,
        run_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        projection_complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
          CHECK (projection_complete IN (0, 1)),
        completed_actions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        total_actions INTEGER,
        progress_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
          CHECK (json_valid(progress_json)),
        error_code TEXT,
        error_message TEXT,
        started_at TEXT,
        completed_at TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

companion.name: companion_dirty_components_delete
companion.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER companion_dirty_components_delete
      AFTER DELETE ON components BEGIN
        INSERT INTO companion_dirty_sources(source_table, source_id, operation, changed_at)
        VALUES ('components', OLD.id, 'delete', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
        ON CONFLICT(source_table, source_id) DO UPDATE SET
          operation = excluded.operation, changed_at = excluded.changed_at;
        UPDATE companion_meta SET projection_revision = projection_revision + 1,
          projection_dirty = 1, dirty_reason = 'source:components',
          source_changed_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
          updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = 1;
      END
